components.name: Running Section Marker
components.description: Continuous §-numbered clause marker in the left margin.
components.css: .ds-clause { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: #777777; position: sticky; top: 24px; }

components.name: Margin Annotation
components.description: Violet-accented aside anchored in the right margin.
components.css: .ds-annotation { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #7b42f5; border-left: 2px solid #7b42f5; padding-left: 8px; }

narrative.overview: The existing per-section numbered badges are taken literally into a continuous running section-clause numbering, like an RFC or the .wasp.ts spec files themselves.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent running §-numbering in the left margin
Violet repurposed as a bounded 'reviewer annotation' accent
Structural micro-labels set in monospace even where body copy is sans
Section dividers are literal rules with a § marker

rules.name: The Margin-Note Rule
rules.body: Violet appears only as a small, clearly-secondary annotation mark — never a primary surface color.

dos: Run section numbering continuously, not as isolated badges.
Confine violet strictly to margin-annotation use.
donts: Don't let JetBrains Mono creep into paragraph prose.
Don't use violet as a section background or button color.
